Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
"Timlagor" <Timlagor...@yahoo.com> escribió en el mensaje
news:MPG.19b6a50c9...@news.freeserve.com...


From online text:

Pier 13, Port of Baltimore [SW:U/PB]
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 2 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play.
During your influence phase, this minion may equip with a non-location,
non-unique equipment card from your hand (this minion must meet the
requirements, if any, of the equipment card). Pay the cost as normal. This
is not an action and cannot be blocked.

It reads "this minion may equip with a non-location, non-unique". So it is
equiping for relative texts such as Black cat. But not for Leather jacket
as it states...

Leather Jacket [Sabbat:C, SW:C/PB/PT/PV, FN:PS, CE:PTo/PTr]
Cardtype: Equipment
Equipment.
If the action to equip with the Leather Jacket is successful, untap the
acting minion at the end of the turn. Bearer may burn Leather Jacket to
prevent all the damage from the opposing minion's strike. A minion can have
only 1 Leather Jacket.

So, LJ only untaps you when you successfully perform the equip action, so it
don't triggers with the Pier 13.

Messages.Body:
From online text:
Pier 13, Port of Baltimore [SW:U/PB]
Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 2 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play.
During your influence phase, this minion may equip with a non-location,
non-unique equipment card from your hand (this minion must meet the
requirements, if any, of the equipment card). Pay the cost as normal.
This
is not an action and cannot be blocked.

So, LJ only untaps you when you successfully perform the equip action,
so it
don't triggers with the Pier 13.

I don't agree. The LJ is still 'EQUIPPED', whether it is an action or
not, so therefore the minion untaps. This is like the way you can swap
LJ's between minions so that they untap...

Please, reread the online text for Leather Jacket and rethink your statement

Leather Jacket [Sabbat:C, SW:C/PB/PT/PV, FN:PS, CE:PTo/PTr]
Cardtype: Equipment
Equipment.
If the action to equip with the Leather Jacket is successful, untap the
acting minion at the end of the turn. Bearer may burn Leather Jacket to
prevent all the damage from the opposing minion's strike. A minion can have
only 1 Leather Jacket.

Look carefully at the first statement "if the action to equip" and Pier 13
last sentence is "This is not an equip action" so this is quite clear to me.

Swaping LJ between your minions, if it is done by the default equip action
covered under 6.1.3 of the rulebook, untaps the acting one. But not rave nor
heidelberg do untap those minions with LJ.
